project_type: Expo / React Native mobile app (Expo SDK ~57, Expo Router) with a Supabase Postgres backend (migrations + pgTAP tests).
build_system: Expo tooling; no bundler step needed for verification. No bun.lock present, so use npx. Native dirs ios/android are CNG-generated; never hand-edit. Postgres major_version = 17 (supabase/config.toml).
test_framework: Jest ~29.7 with jest-expo (client unit/render tests; @testing-library/react-native + test-renderer). pgTAP via `supabase test db` (pg_prove globs every supabase/tests/*.sql).
test_command: npm test   (Jest). Target a file with: npm test -- <path>. pgTAP: npx supabase test db
verification_instructions: Run `npx expo lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm test` from the worktree root; all must pass. Run `npx supabase test db` for the pgTAP suite (needs the local Supabase Docker stack). If Docker is unavailable, document the deferral and statically validate the SQL parses (e.g. `npx supabase db lint` if present, or psql-parse against a scratch DB) rather than claiming a green pgTAP run. Confirm no applied migration file is edited and package.json/package-lock.json are unchanged.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/types/db.ts is a generated types file but is edited by hand here (one Functions entry added) rather than regenerated. No other generated/snapshot files are produced by build or test.
environment_constraints: pgTAP requires the local Supabase stack (Docker). The task's opening message used `supabase db query --linked` against a remote; do NOT run migrations against the linked remote during verification — use the local `supabase test db`. Installed Supabase CLI is v2.119.0. Commit locally only; never push.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: use `npx expo install` for any dependency change (none is needed here — NFR-1 forbids new deps). Routes live in app/; keep all non-route code under src/. Never create/edit ios/ or android/. Run lint + typecheck before declaring done. Applied migrations are immutable; add a new timestamped file.
key_patterns: Money is integer cents end-to-end; format only at the UI boundary via src/lib/money.ts (formatCents, formatSignedCents, formatPercent, pctChange). RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER set search_path = public, derive the user from public.current_user_id() (never a client-passed id), and raise bare error codes as exceptions. Client hooks use @tanstack/react-query; mutation error maps mirror mapPlaceOrderError; zod validates RPC result shape at the boundary. Charts: pure geometry module (unit-tested) + thin react-native-svg renderer that self-measures width via onLayout. Range selector is a tablist with accessibilityState selected. pgTAP tests use begin/plan(N)/pgtap/\ir _helpers.sql/reset role+set role+set_authenticated_claims/finish()/rollback.
